title: Capitol Boat Club
specs: Experienced captains with extensive knowledge of Lake Mendota
Fuel included in all rentals and charters
Membership open to anyone 22 years or older
Members must complete on-the-water training and online Boater Safety Certification before reserving boats
All captains are WI boater safety certified
Boats limited to listed capacity and weight restrictions
Private groups and parties welcome for special event charters

services.desc: 10 or 11 Passenger Boat CapacityWhen booking, the driver counts towards the total capacity Pick-up from Mariner’s Inn, The Edgewater, Warner Park Boat Launch, or Marshall Park Our chartered Madison boat rentals are operated by highly rated and trained captains - all captains are WI boater safety certified. They are here to help keep you safe while you sit back, relax, and enjoy your outing with no stress or concerns. gap: Exact pricing for captained charters and special event charters not stated
blurb: Guests can rent boats or join as members to access a fleet including pontoon boats, ski boats, and deck boats. Rentals and charters include fuel and captains for stress-free outings. Special event charters are available for parties and celebrations with experienced captains.
extraNote: $100 deposit collected at booking, rest charged on day of outing · Deposits non-refundable unless outing canceled due to rain or sustained winds over 15 mph · Cancellations within 48 hours result in full charge except when canceled by Capitol Boat Club for weather · No smoking, grilling, red wine, or pets allowed onboard · Boats must be returned before sunset; no night use allowed
